title: Forward `widgetParams` to the `unmountFn` of connectors
body: If we save some data, like the container node of our custom widget into `widgetParams` it would be great to have it with as param of the `unmountFn` 👍

comments.body:
Hey @iam4x! Do you remember in which cases you needed to access the container node in the connector?

Usually we specify the `unmountFn` function body in the widget, where we have the knowledge of the container node and unmounts its component.

https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/9dcbdd582d082acaea0edeabdc7e5d6cd9173c51/src/widgets/menu/menu.js#L168-L170

To my knowledge, the connector nevers needs to access the container node because it only calls the `unmountFn` given by the widget:

https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/9dcbdd582d082acaea0edeabdc7e5d6cd9173c51/src/connectors/menu/connectMenu.js#L228
I think the original idea here is that if you give a container to the renderfn & make elements. If you don't particularly save it on the instance, you don't have access to that selector to unmount
